skills.name: Disadvantages of rusting and its prevention

worked_example.problem: How is {x} protected from rusting, and why not by painting?
steps: The chain moves, so paint would crack and wear off.
Oil or grease keeps out air and water and lets the chain move.

cards.idea: Rusting weakens iron structures and costs money to repair; rusty nails can cause tetanus.
Painting, oiling, greasing and plastic coating keep out air and water.
Galvanising coats iron with zinc; zinc is more reactive, so it corrodes instead of the iron.

pick.q: Why does a galvanised sheet not rust even when scratched?
pick.r: Zinc is more reactive, so it corrodes instead of the iron.
w: Zinc is less reactive than iron.
e: Zinc is more reactive than iron.
pick.y: Sacrificial protection by the more reactive zinc.

pick.q: Blocks of magnesium are fixed to the iron hull of a ship. Why?
pick.r: Magnesium corrodes instead of the iron.
e: Blocks do not make it float.
pick.y: Magnesium is more reactive than iron: sacrificial protection.

pick.q: Which is a disadvantage of rusting?
w: It stops iron from conducting heat.
e: That is not the main problem.

pick.q: Why should a cut from a rusty nail be treated quickly?
pick.y: Tetanus germs live in soil and on dirty, rusty objects.

e: Paint would crack as the chain moves.
Plastic would wear off a moving chain.
Plating a chain is costly; oil is used.
pick.y: Oil keeps out air and water and lets it move.

e: Oil would be wiped off and collect dust.
pick.y: Paint keeps out air and water.

e: Zinc can react with acidic foods.
pick.y: Tin is not poisonous and does not react with the food.

e: Chromium is too costly for roofs.
Plastic would be damaged by the sun.
pick.y: Zinc protects the iron even when scratched.

right.text: Galvanising is coating iron with zinc.
Food cans are plated with tin.
Paint keeps out air and water.

wrong.text: Copper blocks protect a ship's hull by corroding instead of the iron.
wrong.explain: Copper is less reactive than iron; zinc or magnesium is used.

wrong.text: Keeping iron tools in a wet place prevents rusting.
